apropos.desc: Lists all cvars or commands with the specified substring somewhere in their name or descrition.

ban.desc: Block the player's IP, preventing them from connecting. Also kicks them.

banlist.desc: Displays a list of every banned player on the server.

bestweapon.desc: Works like 'impulse', for compat with other engines.

bind.desc: Changes the action associated with each keyboard button. Use eg "bind ctrl+shift+alt+k kill" for special modifiers (should be used only after more basic modifiers).

capture.desc: Captures realtime action to a named video file. Check the capture* cvars to control driver/codecs/rates.

capturedemo.desc:
capturedemo foo.dem foo.avi - Captures a named demo to a named video file.
Demo capturing is performed offscreen when possible, allowing arbitrary video sizes or smooth captures on underpowered hardware.

capturepause.desc: Pauses the video capture, allowing you to avoid capturing uninteresting parts. This is a toggle, so reuse the same command to resume capturing again.

changelevel.desc: Continues the game on a different map. The current map can be reentered later when a starting position for the new map is specified as a second argument.

changing.desc: Part of network protocols. This command should not be used manually.

check_maps.desc: Obsolete, specific to ktpro. Modern mods should use search_begin instead.

cl_transfer.desc: Connect to a different server, disconnecting from the current server only when the new server replies.

conactivate.desc: Brings focus to the named console. Will not do anything if the named console is not created yet (so be sure to do any echos before using this command)

conclear.desc: Clears a named console (instead of just the main one)

conecho.desc:
conecho consolename The Text To Echo
Echos text to a named console instead of just the main one.

conecho_center.desc:
conecho_center consolename The Text To Echo
Use "" for the main console.
Any added lines will be aligned to the middle of the console.

conmenu.desc:
conmenu <callback>
Creates a new (built-in) scripted menu. any following commands that define scipted menu items will add their items to this new menu. The callback will be called with argument 'cancel' when the menu is closed.

connect.desc:
connect scheme://address:port
Connect to a server. Use a scheme of rtc[s]://broker/gamename to connect via a webrtc broker.Use a scheme of ws[s]://server to connect via websockets.Use a scheme of tcp:// or tls:// to connect via non-udp protocols.Use a scheme of dtls://server to connect securely.Use irc://network:6667/user[@channel] to connect via an irc server. Not recommended.
Default port is port . NQ:. QW:. Q2:. Q3:.

connectbr.desc:
connect address:port
Connect to a qw server using the best route we can detect.

connectnq.desc: Connects to the specified server, defaulting to port . Also disables QW/Q2/Q3/DP handshakes preventing them from being favoured, so should only be used when you actually want NQ protocols specifically.

connectq2e.desc: Connects to the specified server, defaulting to port .

connectqe.desc: Connects to the specified server, defaulting to port . Also forces the use of DTLS and QE-specific handshakes. You will also need to ensure the dtls_psk_* cvars are set properly or the server will refuse the connection.

connecttcp.desc: Connect to a server using the tcp:// prefix

cripple.desc: Block the player's ability to move.

cuff.desc: Slap handcuffs on the player, preventing them from being able to attack.

cvar_purgedefaults.desc: Resets all cvar defaults to back to the engine's default. Does not change their active value.

cvar_resettodefaults_all.desc: Resets all cvars to the mod's default value.

cvar_resettodefaults_nosaveonly.desc: Resets all unsaved cvars to the mod's default value.

cvar_resettodefaults_saveonly.desc: Resets all saved cvars to the mod's default value (without changing unsaved cvars).

cvarlist.desc: Lists all cvars. eg, 'cvarlist -cvd *' can be used to list all cvars with a value other than the mod's default.

cvarreset.desc: Resets the named cvar to its default value.

cvarwatch.desc: Prints a notification when the named cvar is changed. Also displays the start/end of configs. Alternatively, use '-watch foo' on the commandline.

defer.desc: Issues the given command after a time delay. Disabled if ruleset_allow_in is 0.

demo_jump.desc: Jump to a specified time in a demo. Prefix with a + or - for a relative offset. Seeking backwards will restart the demo and the fast forward, which can take some time in long demos.

demo_jump_end.desc: Jump to the next intermission message.

demo_nudge.desc: Nudge the demo by one frame. Argument should be +1 or -1. Nudging backwards is limited.

devmap.desc: Loads a map in developer mode (sv_cheats 1), for Quake III compat.

download_map_url.desc: Redundant - individual maps will probably download faster than the user can open a browser at the given url.

envmap.desc: Legacy name for the screenshot_cubemap command.

find.desc: Lists all cvars or commands with the specified substring somewhere in their name or descrition.

flocate.desc: Searches for a named file, and displays where it can be found in the OS's filesystem

fs_changegame.desc: Switch between different manifests (or registered games)

fs_changemod.desc: Provides the backend functionality of a transient online installer. Eg, for quaddicted's map/mod database.

fs_hash.desc: Computes a hash of the specified file.

heartbeat.desc: Sends an update or ping to the master server so the current server can remain listed.

identify.desc: Looks up a player's ip to see if they're using a different name

impulse.desc: Sends an impulse number to the server (read: weapon change).

in.desc: Issues the given command after a time delay. Disabled if ruleset_allow_in is 0.

inc.desc: Adds a value to the named cvar. Use a negative value if you wish to decrease the cvar's value.

join.desc: Switches away from spectator mode, optionally connecting to a different server.

kick.desc: Removes a player from the server, provide the name or IP of the desired player.

listconfigs.desc: Displays a list of every installed config file.

listfonts.desc: Displays a list of every installed font.

listip.desc: Displays a list of ever player the server has penalties for.

listmaps.desc: Displays a list of installed maps.

listskins.desc: Displays a list of every installed or downloaded QuakeWorld player skin.

listskyboxes.desc: Displays a list of available custom skyboxes that can be set with r_skybox, type or click an entry.

loadsky.desc: For compat with DarkPlaces, please use r_skybox.

map.desc: Begins a new game on the specified map.

map_restart.desc: Restarts the server and reloads the map while flushing level cache, for general use and Quake III compat.

mapcluster.desc: Sets this server up as a cluster-server gateway. Additional processes will be used to host individual maps. If an argument is given then that will be the name of the map that new clients will initially be directed to. This can also be used for single-player to off-load nearly all server functions - use the 'ssv' command to direct each subserver.

mapedit.desc: Loads the named map without any gamecode active.

maplist.desc: Displays a list of installed maps.

maps.desc: Displays a list of installed maps.

menucallback.desc: Explicitly invoke the active script menu's callback function with the given option set.

menucombos.desc:
x y caption cvarname [caption0] [value0] [caption1] [value1] ...
if 'caption0' is { then the options will be parsed from trailing lines

menuslider.desc: x y caption cvarname min max

mod_bspx_injest.desc: Injests supplemental files (like .lits) into a new bspx file. REMEMBER TO BACK-UP FIRST!

mod_bspx_list.desc: Lists all lumps (and their sizes) in the specified bsp.

mod_bspx_strip.desc: Strips a named extension lump from a bsp file.

mod_buildcubemaps.desc: Automatically builds cubemaps for each env_cubemap present in the map.

mod_findcubemaps.desc: Scans the entities of a map to find reflection env_cubemap sites and determines the nearest one to each surface.

mod_realign.desc: Reads the named bsp and writes it back out with only alignment changes.

mod_showent.desc: Allows you to quickly search through a map's entities.

mod_terrain_convert.desc:
mod_terrain_convert [mapname] [texkill]
Convert a terrain to the current format. If texkill is specified, only tiles with the named texture will be converted, and tiles with that texture will be stripped. This is a slow operation.

mute.desc: Mutes the player (no voice or chat), shaming them.

noclip.desc: Disables clipping, allowing you to fly through the level.

observe.desc: Switches to spectator mode, optionally connecting to a different server.

path.desc: prints a list of current search paths.

pkg.desc: Provides a way to install / list / disable / purge packages via the console.

precaches.desc: Displays a list of current server precaches.

profile_ssqc.desc:
Displays how much time has been spent in various QC functions since this command was last used.
If pr_enable_profiling is set, profiling will be enabled automatically, and can be used to list spawn functions.
Add an arg with value 1 if you wish to avoid purging timing information.

quit.desc: Use this command when you get angry. Does not save any cvars. Use cfg_save to save settings, or use the menu for a prompt.

r_converteffectinfo.desc: Attempt to convert particle effects made for a certain other engine.

r_editlights_clone.desc: Duplicate the current light (with a new origin)

r_editlights_copyinfo.desc: store a copy of all properties (except origin) of the selected light

r_editlights_edit.desc: Changes named properties on the current light.

r_editlights_editall.desc: Like r_editlights_edit, but affects all lights instead of just the selected one.

r_editlights_lock.desc: Blocks changing the current light according the crosshair.

r_editlights_pasteinfo.desc: apply the stored properties onto the selected light (making it exactly identical except for origin)

r_editlights_reload.desc: Reload static rtlights. Argument can be rtlights|statics|bsp|none to override the source.

r_editlights_spawn.desc: Spawn a new light with default properties

r_editlights_togglecorona.desc: Toggles the current light's corona field.

r_editlights_toggleshadow.desc: Toggles the shadow flag on the current light.

r_imageformats.desc: Prints out a list of the usable hardware pixel formats.

r_imagelist.desc: Prints out a list of the currently-known textures.

r_shaderlist.desc: Prints out a list of the currently-loaded shaders.

register_bestweapon.desc: Normally set via a mod's default.cfg file

removeip.desc: Removes an IP Address from the penality list.

rerecord.desc: Reconnects to the previous/current server, but starts recording a clean demo.

save.desc: Saves the game to the named location.

savegame.desc: Saves the game to the named location.

savegame_legacy.desc: Saves the game in a format compatible with vanilla Quake. Anything not supported by that format will be lost.

say.desc: Send a chat message to everyone on the server.

screenshot_cubemap.desc:
screenshot_cubemap <name> [size]
Takes 6 screenshots forming a single cubemap.

screenshot_mega.desc:
screenshot_mega <name> [width] [height]
Takes a screenshot with explicit sizes that are not tied to the size of your monitor, allowing for true monstrosities.

screenshot_stereo.desc:
screenshot_stereo <name> [width] [height]
Takes a simple stereo screenshot.

screenshot_vr.desc:
screenshot_vr <name> [width]
Takes a spherical stereoscopic panorama image, for viewing with VR displays.

set.desc: Changes the current value of the named cvar, creating it if it doesn't yet exist.

set_calc.desc: Sets the named cvar to the result of a (complex) expression.

set_tp.desc: Identical to set. Included for compatibility with ezquake where ruleset restrictions on macros are on commands rather than cvars.

seta.desc: Changes the current value of the named cvar, creating it if it doesn't yet exist. Also forces the archive flag so that the cvar will always be written into any saved configs.

seta_calc.desc: Sets the named cvar to the result of a (complex) expression. Also forces the archive flag so that the cvar will always be written into any saved configs.

setfl.desc: Changes the current value of the named cvar, creating it if it doesn't yet exist. The third arg allows setting cvar flags and should be u, s, or a. This command should normally be used only inside default.cfg.

showpic.desc:
showpic <imagename> <placename> <x> <y> <zone> [width] [height] [touchcommand]
Displays an image onscreen, that potentially has a key binding attached to it when clicked/touched.
zone should be one of: TL, TR, BL, BR, MM, TM, BM, ML, MR. This serves as an extra offset to move the image around the screen without any foreknowledge of the screen resolution.

showpic_removeall.desc: removes any pictures inserted with the showpic command.

sky.desc: For compat with Quakespasm, please use r_skybox.

skygroup.desc: Provides a way to associate a skybox name with a series of maps, so that the requested skybox will override on a per-map basis.

spdevmap.desc: Loads a map in single-player developer mode (sv_cheats 1), for Quake III compat.

spmap.desc: Loads a map in single-player mode, for Quake III compat.

startdemos.desc: Sets the demoreel list, but does not start playing them (use the 'demos' command for that)

status.desc: Prints info about the current server.

stealthmute.desc: Mutes the player, without telling them, while pretending that their messages are still being broadcast. For use against people that would escalate on expiry or externally.

sv_downloadchunksperframe.desc: Flawed - downloads instead proceed at the client's drate (or rate) setting instead of ignoring it entirely.

sv_enableprofile.desc: Debug setting that is not implemented.

sv_gamedir.desc: Change the gamedir reported to clients, without changing any actual paths on the server.

sv_lightstyle.desc: Overrides lightstyles from the server's console, mostly for debug use.

sv_progtype.desc: Use sv_progs instead. Using to block .dll loading is insufficient with buggy clients around.

sv_saveentfile.desc: Dumps a copy of the map's entities to disk, so that it can be edited and used as a replacement for slightly customised maps.

sv_speedcheck.desc: Obsolete - movetime is instead metered over time, instead of randomly kicking everyone due to dodgy timer hardware on the server.

sys_browserredirect.desc: Navigates the browser to a different url. For sites using quake maps as a more interesting sitemap.

sys_register_file_associations.desc: Register FTE as the default handler for various file+protocol types, using FreeDesktop standards.

sys_select_timeout.desc: Redundant - server will throttle according to tick rates instead.

tcpconnect.desc: Connect to a server using the tcp:// prefix

toggle.desc:
Toggles a cvar between two values
toggle CVARNAME [newval [altval]]

unban.desc: Unbans or removes an IP Address from the penality list, alias to removeip.

unbindall.desc: A dangerous command that forgets ALL your key settings. For use only in default.cfg.

unsavegame.desc: Wipes an existing saved game from disk.

version.desc: Reports engine revision and optional compile-time settings.

vstr.desc: Executes the string value of the cvar, much like if it were an alias. For compatibility with q3.

which.desc: Searches for a named file, and displays where it can be found in the OS's filesystem
